verdict.rationale: Tilled is a payments platform for onboarding merchants, so a documented coverage map of countries, local payment methods and settlement currencies is a fair question for it. The evidence covers onboarding flows, pricing templates and payout speed, but never mentions supported countries, local payment methods by region, local-currency settlement, or any coverage map. Absence of evidence for an applicable capability is none.

support.subject: As a founder, sellers can join from where they are — supported onboarding countries, local payment methods, and local-currency settlement documented as a coverage map, not discovered ticket by ticket
